about_short_description.short_description: Related is a martech company that specializes in advice, data analytics, and ROI modelling services.

product.name: Loyalty and Reward Program Platform
product.description: A modular platform to design, customize, and manage loyalty and reward programs with features like points, tiers, triggers, and gamification.

product.name: Travel Catalogue
product.description: A plug-and-play travel rewards catalogue offering customers flight, hotel, and car rental rewards as part of loyalty programs.

product.name: Segmentation Module
product.description: A module for advanced customer segmentation using demographic, financial, and behavioral data to personalize rewards and communications.

product.name: Gamification Features
product.description: Gamification tools that incorporate game-like elements such as challenges, badges, and mini-games to increase customer engagement in reward programs.

product.name: Referral Module
product.description: A plug-and-play module that incentivizes customers to refer new clients, turning satisfied customers into advocates.

product.name: NFT Rewards
product.description: A feature to launch non-fungible token (NFT) rewards quickly as part of loyalty programs.
